producer: Claude implementation agent; not an independent reviewer

evidence.detail: Against a real control store (SQLite) in a temporary folder, real OpenSSH keys and real signature checks, with the owner bootstrapped through control_membership.admit. Rows ac1/no-record-is-report (with no command sent a project, a second project, a plain repository and no project each read report and the store holds no mode record), ac1/own-record-per-scope (the owner's signed command puts orchard in act as one journal record and one record space:mode:project:orchard; the plain repository and no project get records of their own; meadow stays in report throughout; a second spelling of the plain repository is the same scope), ac1/act-beside-report (one event ends a fixture folder of orchard, in act, and one of meadow, in report: orchard's is removed in the same call, meadow's is due and still on disk), ac1/history (three switches of one scope: the history holds each with from, to, when and the owner's packet, each recorded signature still verifies against the owner's key, since names the current one, each switch is one journal record with the owner as principal holding the scope, the old and new mode and the command). Green: proof/VELDO-0331/suite-green.txt.

Row ac1/owner-signs, each refused with nothing written: the owner's name signed with an intruder's key, a command changed after signing, no signature, no packet, a person without project_owner, a project_owner scoped to one repository, an unknown principal (all not_authorized); both host principals (space_not_permitted:space_mode, logged with principal and command name); a project nobody bound and an unnamed plain repository (space_unknown_scope); a mode that is neither report nor act; the owner's earlier act packet sent again after the switch back, and the same command under a new id with the old signature; the store's generic entity command writing a mode record (entity_owned).

Declared falsifier space331-one-mode-for-installation (one mode record for the installation): ac1/act-beside-report red, meadow's due folder is removed; noop copy green. Also space331-mode-signature-unchecked (the signature check dropped): ac1/owner-signs red. proof/VELDO-0331/mutations.txt.

Review finding 1 (lead decision 1), rows ac1/ledger-checks-signature and ac1/ledger-checks-sender. The mode transition (_t_mode) checks the command itself inside its transaction, with the control_membership module beside the ledger file and not the one a caller passes. The review's probe as a refused row: a space_mode command given to the store as the authority whose inner command names nobody and whose signature is 'not-a-signature' is refused not_authorized with nothing written, and so is the same sent through the Ledger's own command path as the journal signer. Also refused not_authorized through the Ledger's command path: the owner's name and command with an intruder's signature, the owner's signed report command with its mode changed to act, a person who is not the owner with that person's real signature; both host principals are refused space_not_permitted:space_mode. The sender: the owner's real signed command is refused when the store is given it as the authority, when the store is given it under the owner's name, id and nonce (it did not come from this Ledger), when the Ledger sends it as the journal signer, and under another command id or another nonce. The same packet through set_mode is then accepted, with the owner, the command id and the nonce of the signed command on its journal record, and sent again it writes nothing.

Review finding 3 (lead decision 3), row ac1/act-refused-until-built. With no check installed the owner's correctly signed act command is refused space_act_unbuilt:VELDO-0332,VELDO-0339 for a project, a plain repository and no project, with no journal record and no mode record, and the refusal is in the observations. With the check of one condition installed the refusal names only the other ticket; a built check that refuses is space_act_refused:<condition> and is asked for the scope of the command; a report command is never refused for it. Every later row of the suite runs with two fixture checks that allow act, standing in for VELDO-0332 and VELDO-0339; no production code installs one.

Review falsifiers, each with its noop copy green (proof/VELDO-0331/mutations.txt): space331-transition-trusts-signature (the transition does not read the owner and the signature): ac1/ledger-checks-signature red, the command with an intruder's signature is written. space331-transition-trusts-sender (the transition does not read who sent the command): ac1/ledger-checks-sender red, the owner's real command given to the store as the authority is written. space331-act-with-no-check-built (act accepted with no check built, as it was): ac1/act-refused-until-built red, the scope is in act.

Rows ac2/admission-by-scope (one pool, floor 20000 MB, free 30000 MB, need 15000 MB for both: the run of the report-mode project is advised and the run of the act-mode project waits, each with pool, need, free, held and floor; the waiting run's held is the advised run's need; the plain repository and no project are judged by their own modes), ac2/advised-counts-as-held (an act-mode run needing 5000 MB, which fits the free space alone and not beside the advised run, waits; after the advised hold is released the same need is admitted; a report-mode run that fits is admitted), ac2/signal-by-scope (Signal carries out the item of an act-mode project, plain repository and no project before it returns, and leaves the item of a report-mode project due with its folder on disk), ac2/adoption-by-scope (a container inside a recorded worktree is adopted with the worktree as parent and owner for the act-mode project, and is a report record with the proposed owner and no owner for the report-mode project; after that project's switch to act the same call adopts it and the report record is the item).

The same rows read the three callers as units: control_space_admission.judge, held and admit; control_space_signal.signal; control_space_reconcile.adopt_inside_worktree. Each asks Ledger.acts for one scope.

Declared falsifier space331-advised-not-held (advised holds left out of what is held): ac2/advised-counts-as-held red, the act-mode run is admitted into space the advised run was promised; noop copy green. One further case per reader, each red with its noop copy green: space331-signal-reads-no-mode, space331-admission-reads-no-mode, space331-adopts-in-report.

Review finding 2 (lead decision 2), row ac2/hold-keeps-its-scope. The hold record holds the scope it was placed under; one placed with no scope is of no project; a hold or an issued run for a scope the declarations do not name is refused space_unknown_scope. A run the authority issued with a scope gives its hold that scope: a hold naming another is refused space_hold_scope, a host principal's hold command has no scope parameter (invalid_input:parameters), and the runner's hold for the issued run records the issued scope. The answer advised for the hold of an act-mode scope is refused space_answer_mode:act from space-runner and from the authority, with nothing written and the hold still waiting; control_space_admission.admit takes no scope from its caller, reads the hold's, and makes that run wait. The mode is read when the answer is written: a hold placed while its scope was in report is refused advised once the scope is in act, and advised again after the switch back.

Review falsifier space331-advised-for-act-hold (admit does not read the mode of the hold's scope): ac2/hold-keeps-its-scope red, the runner's advised answer for an act-mode hold is written; noop copy green.

Rows ac3/switch-back-accepted (orchard in act with a due item and a waiting hold open: the owner's report command is accepted at once, by one journal record; the record holds the switch back; scopes nobody switched stay in act) and ac3/then-due-and-nothing-removed (the project's next event writes due, its folder and file stay on disk and nothing is carried out; the item due before the switch is still due and on disk; a run that would wait is advised; a container inside its worktree is reported, not adopted).
Ledger.set_mode accepts report for a scope in act with no condition read; a command for the mode the scope is already in is accepted and writes nothing (row ac1/own-record-per-scope).
Declared falsifier space331-switch-back-refused (the switch back refused): ac3/switch-back-accepted red, the row that sends it gets space_mode_locked and the scope stays in act; noop copy green.

checks.name: fast checks
checks.command: After the review fix: bash scripts/check_template_sync.sh; bash scripts/check_docs.sh; python3 .veldo/validate.py all; suites 130_veldo_0296_space_section, 131_veldo_0338_project_space_file, 132_veldo_0297_space_ledger and 133_veldo_0326_space_principals still green; every registered mutation anchor in the control_space modules (39 cases) still matches once; python3 scripts/update_index.py leaves specs/index.md unchanged

checks.name: gate
checks.reason: The build and the review fix ran single suites and fast checks only. The lead runs ./scripts/verify.sh through the gate lock; the eleven registered teeth cases (finding 331) were run here through the driver's own materialize() and worker(), not through the teeth run.

assumptions: ACT IS REFUSED UNTIL ITS CHECKS ARE BUILT (review, lead decision 3). The ledger names the two conditions and their tickets (ACT_CONDITIONS: clean_report_days VELDO-0332, no_unconfirmed_pending_group VELDO-0339) and refuses a switch to act in the transition while the Ledger was given no check for one of them. The seam is the Ledger's act_checks, {condition: check(scope)}: it exists because AC1 to AC3 cannot be shown without a scope in act, and only the suite's fixture fills it. Nothing in production builds a Ledger with a check, so no scope can be put in act today. The gate's space steps (the third condition, VELDO-0339) are not a named condition here; 0339 adds what it checks. The specs of VELDO-0332 and VELDO-0339 each say the ticket removes its part of the refusal when it lands.

The owner is read as an active person member holding project_owner whose scope covers the named scope space (the universal scope does). A project_owner scoped to single repositories is refused. The command is the same packet shape a host principal sends ({command, signature}, namespace veldo-command), verified against the principal's active key in the store's keyring; the store command commits against the versions of that membership and key and consumes the owner's nonce.

The history holds every switch including the current one, last; since repeats the current one's time and command. Design 4.7 words history as each earlier switch; the AC words it as every switch, and the superset serves both. The history entry has from, to, at and command. What was checked for a switch to act is added by 0332 and 0339.
The time on a switch is the number the caller read; no clock is read in the ledger. Days in the installation's time zone are 0332's.

A command for the mode the scope is already in is accepted and writes nothing. The owner's packet sent again writes nothing: the store answers a command id it holds with a content conflict or the first result.
The mode command is refused for a scope the declarations do not name (space_unknown_scope). A read of an unknown scope, or of no scope (a report record has no owner), answers report.

space_mode is registered beside OPERATIONS and not in it, so the VELDO-0326 row that lists the authority's commands is unchanged; the 0326 suite already proves both host principals are refused the mode switch.

Signal, admission and reconcile do not exist yet (0301, 0316, 0315). This ticket creates the three files with only the part that reads the mode. control_space_signal.signal is given the carrying out of a due item as a callable (rules and removers are 0299 to 0301); the suite's callable deletes a fixture folder and writes the outcome removed. In report mode it leaves every item due; removing an item that carries the owner's confirmation is 0301 and 0320.

Reconcile's adoption rule is read as the one row of 8.8 whose result depends on the mode: a Docker object with no run label inside a recorded worktree (design 6.4). Every other adoption row adopts in both modes (0320 AC1). Finding the object and its worktree is 0307; control_space_reconcile.adopt_inside_worktree is given both.
No CLI verb, API action or console control sends the mode command yet (0313, 0319); the suite signs the owner's packet with ssh-keygen as the CLI will.
The bundle's commit and tree name the implementation commit; the bundle itself is in the next commit, as the earlier space tickets did.

control_space_admission holds the per-pool rule in its smallest form because AC2 cannot be shown without it: free minus what admitted and advised holds still hold, against need plus floor. Free space is given by the caller. Needs, the admission requested event, the freed mark and the Runner are 0316 and 0334.

THE SENDER OF A MODE COMMAND (review, lead decision 1). The store gives a transition the command's parameters and not its principal, and control_store.py is outside this ticket's footprint. The Ledger therefore keeps the command it handed to the store while the store runs it, and the transition accepts a space_mode command only when the parameters it was given are that command's very object; a space_mode command given to the store by any other caller has none and is refused. The transition then requires the outer principal, command id and nonce to equal the signed command's, and verifies the owner and the signature from the store with the control_membership module beside the ledger file. The time the membership and key are judged at is the command's own at, which the caller reads; no clock is read in the ledger.

THE SCOPE OF A HOLD (review, lead decision 2). The hold record gains scope (design 4.3 names none; 6.7 says whose it is). A run or gate the authority issues may carry a scope (issue's scope, recorded on the run record only when given, so earlier run records are unchanged), and its hold takes that scope whatever the hold names. A hold whose run carries none takes the scope place_hold is given, else no project; a host principal's packet cannot name one. Naming the scope when a run is issued (the unit's project, the gated repository, a wrapped run's working folder) is the Runner's and the dispatch contract's, VELDO-0316 and 0317: until they pass it, a runner's hold is of no project.

Only advised for an act-mode hold is refused. The answer waiting for a hold of a report-mode scope is still recorded: the VELDO-0297 suite records a waiting answer with no mode record, and a run that waits where it could have been advised removes nothing. Admission itself never gives that answer.

Noted by the review for other tickets and not changed here: ledger.adopt is not refused for a report-mode scope and nothing in the ledger stops the carrying out of a report-mode item; that safety is VELDO-0301 and 0320.
rollback: Switch every scope back to report, then revert the change. Mode records stay in the journal; a reverted Ledger does not declare the kind and reads no mode.
